DLDD_CONFIG_WITH_VALID_ZERO_THRESHOLDS.desc: DLDD thresholds, grace period, and retention period may be zero.

DLDD_CONFIG_WITH_ZERO_POLLING_INTERVAL.desc: DLDD polling intervals must be positive.

DLDD_CONFIG_WITH_ZERO_RECOVERY_SAMPLES.desc: DLDD source recovery samples must be positive.

DLDD_CONFIG_WITH_ZERO_ACK_TIMEOUT.desc: DLDD fault evidence acknowledgement timeout must be positive.

DLDD_CONFIG_WITH_ZERO_RECHECK_INTERVAL.desc: DLDD active fault recheck interval must be positive.

DLDD_CONFIG_WITH_ZERO_SETTLE_TIME.desc: DLDD rules inbox settle time must be positive.

DLDD_CONFIG_WITH_INVALID_THRESHOLD.desc: DLDD thresholds must be unsigned integers.
